thread:
incident-bot: Paging: batcher-scheduler queue latency on prod-west exceeded threshold (p95 ~1.6s). Alert A-2468. Affected pool: continuous-batch-prod-west. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/batching-latency

oncall_jordan: acked. jumping in. grabbing dashboards now — p95 spiking around 11:12 UTC, throughput steady but queues are growing.

oncall_jordan: quick question — is this after the Canary large-batch rollout last night?

eli_eng: yes, we rolled the large-batch-path to 30% at 03:00 UTC. Telemetry shows larger mean batch sizes (x1.8) and a tail in scheduling latency.

maya_sre: adding context: some customers report slowed responses (chat UIs hang a few hundred ms then stream). support docket 8792 has two customers flagged.

zoe_support: flagged customers: acme-inc, triageai, mobile-chat. acme reported a 2x slower interactive loop. I've opened a priority support note.

oncall_jordan: mitigation plan idea: 1) temporarily lower continuous-batching.max_delay_ms from 40 -> 15 to favor latency (will reduce throughput). 2) enable stricter per-key rate limiter at 200 qps per tenant for 15m. 3) rollback large-batch-path flag to 0 if needed. Thoughts?

eli_eng: +1. lowering max_delay should reduce p95 quickly. I can push config change to prod-west. If we see throughput drop too much, we can enable burst scaling.

maya_sre: remember: lowering max_delay increases GPU util and per-token cost. inform product / billing if we keep it >30m.

oncall_jordan: executing step 1 now. Pushing via config API.

noncall_jordan: ```
# change continuous batch param
curl -X POST "https://config.internal.redwood/api/v1/pools/prod-west/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"continuous_batching.max_delay_ms":15}'
```

oncall_jordan: response: 200 OK. rolling to 3 zones (a,b,c) sequentially. patch id cfg-8821.

eli_eng: seeing p95 drop in zone-a to ~520ms within 30s. zone-b still ramping. good sign.

maya_sre: starting step 2: enable per-tenant rate limiter for the spike window. I'll apply a soft quota so we can quickly revert.

maya_sre: ```
# soft quota enforcement
curl -X POST "https://throttle.internal.redwood/api/v1/rules" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"tenant","limit_qps":200,"window":"15m","reason":"mitigation A-2468"}'
```

maya_sre: rule applied id throttle-472. watch for 429 rate increase.

zoe_support: customers notified via support channels: message queued to acme-inc + triageai. letting them know we're doing temporary throttles and config changes.

eli_eng: monitoring: 429s at edge rose from 0 to ~35/min for a handful of keys — acceptable. Global p95 down to ~480ms after all zones patched.

oncall_jordan: excellent. rolling back the large-batch-path flag is on standby in case tail persists. I won't flip it yet.

maya_sre: putting a note to product: we traded throughput for latency. If product wants throughput back, options: 1) revert throttle + increase autoscale, 2) revert max_delay change and tolerate tail.

eli_eng: we should also capture a short eval run with the current params to quantify quality/regression. I'll trigger eval-quick on the affected model set.

noncall_jordan: scheduled a canary test: eval-quick job 554 started.

maya_sre: handing off to next oncall @maya_sre (taking over). Summary for handoff: alert A-2468 (batcher queue tail). Mitigations applied: continuous_batching.max_delay_ms 40->15 (cfg-8821), tenant soft-throttle 200 qps (throttle-472). Observed: p95 dropped ~1.6s -> ~480ms, small increase in 429s. Support notified for 3 customers. Keep an eye on cost telemetry and 429s.

maya_sre: ETA to reassess: 30m. If p95 creeps >700ms or 429s >200/min, plan: revert throttle and enable extra compute burst (scale up GPUs) or rollback large-batch-path.

zoe_support: will follow up with the flagged customers and update ticket 8792.

eli_eng: adding housekeeping: I'll capture profiler traces for the batch scheduler in the period 11:08-11:24 and upload to the incident folder.

incident-bot: Incident A-2468 status changed: acknowledged -> mitigated (partial). Timeline: 11:12 alert -> 11:16 config change -> 11:20 p95 improvement.

maya_sre: taking point now. Jordan you can stand down. Thanks for the quick pull.

oncall_jordan: thanks team. I'll be reachable if anything spikes back up. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: closing handoff note here. will update incident doc with follow-up actions (postmortem candidate: evaluate large-batch rollout safety checks).
